goal: Compile a validated work-order into deterministic closed-question briefings for cheap execution agents.

inputs.description: Fixture used to prove the E6-2 claim briefing compiler.
Selected pack rubrics compiled into closed questions.

constraints: Use only validated work-order and pack-contract inputs.
Emit closed questions with declared allowed answers and answer contracts.

claims_to_produce.statement: The claim briefing compiler emits deterministic JSON from a valid work-order and selected pack rubrics.
The briefing validator rejects open-ended judgment questions before a cheap agent receives them.

stop_conditions: Stop if any generated question lacks closed_question=true.
Stop if an open-ended question passes output validation.
Stop if a selected pack contract is missing or invalid.
